After 6 weeks of training, however, subjects increased activation by an additional 2% (1 10). Similarly, Pucci and colleagues (174) reported an increase in voluntary activation from 96% to 98% after 3 weeks of training the quadriceps muscles. These results are consistent with research showing that trained athletes display greater muscle activation during high-intensity resistance exercise compared to nonathletes.
